```{r}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/grady/OneDrive/Desktop/EA Games proj/vgchartz.csv/vgchartz.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, 
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```



```{r}
#Selected only games published by EA
EA_games <- data |> filter(publisher %in% c("EA Sports", "Electronic Arts"))

#Removed all titles lacking proper sales data, removed useless columns, and arranged by game name
EA_games_cleaned <- EA_games |> 
  drop_na(total) |> 
  select(-shipped, -vgc) |> 
  arrange(name)

EA_games_cleaned$platform <- as.factor(EA_games_cleaned$platform)
 EA_games_cleaned
```


```{R}
EA_games_cleaned <- EA_games_cleaned |>
  mutate(
    # Create a new column with the grouped names
    platform_grouped = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(platform), "ps") ~ "PlayStation",
      str_detect(tolower(platform), "x") ~ "Xbox",
      str_detect(tolower(platform), "pc") ~ "PC",
      TRUE ~ "Other" # A catch-all for Nintendo, Sega, etc.
    ),
    # Now convert the cleaned column into a factor
    platform_grouped = as.factor(platform_grouped)
  ) 

EA_games_cleaned$developer <- as.factor(EA_games_cleaned$developer)
EA_games_cleaned$date <- as.Date(EA_games_cleaned$date)

EA_games_cleaned <- EA_games_cleaned |>
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date),
    day = day(date),
    day_of_year = yday(date)
  ) 
  
  
```

```{R}
EA_sports <- EA_games_cleaned |> 
  filter(publisher == "EA Sports")

sports_merged <- EA_sports |> 
  group_by(name) |> 
  summarise(
    release_date = first(date),
  
    across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
  )

write.csv(sports_merged, "EA_sports_merged.csv")
write.csv(EA_sports, "EA_sports_only.csv")

```



```{r}
save(data, file = "EA_games_cleaned")

write.csv(EA_games_cleaned, "EA_games_clean.csv")

```
